subject: Confirmation requested on the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the

messages.text: At Placement Zone 2, the geotechnical report doesn't clearly speak to the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench backfill -- can the civil inspector sign off on it as shown? This is becoming more pressing as backfill work approaches. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.

The compaction and cover requirements are satisfied as shown in Grading Plan C-201; no design change is needed for the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench backfill.
